# Parse file names and create directories for each unique file_name
import re
from collections import defaultdict

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_files/', entry_type='files')

# Extract unique file names (e.g., slides, video_recording)
file_names = set()
for f in files:
    # f is like "/home/adam/documents/work/meetings_files/2023-apr-03__slides.ppt"
    basename = f.split('/')[-1]
    # split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = basename.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # file_name is everything before the last dot
    file_name = rest.rsplit('.', 1)[0]
    file_names.add(file_name)

print("Unique file names:", file_names)

# Create directories for each file_name inside meetings_files
for name in file_names:
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{name}"
    # Check if directory exists
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path)
    if not exists:
        print(f"Creating directory: {dir_path}")
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    else:
        print(f"Directory already exists: {dir_path}")
